sources.scope: Derive actual all-complex-Schwartz tested PDE with both products L1, genuine complex volume-L2 classes/AE embeddings, actual TD Laplacian and MemSobolev2 using B2=I-(2pi)^-2 Delta. Genuine conditional same originalD before epsilon/f, one actualu before allC2 compactcutoffs; retain parent properties. No real mixed-second representatives/Hessian, original weighted localized-domain membership/core/Bochner, BL/Poincare/epsilon0/measurable fiber selector/full4.1/main/composition. Reflected/RGO laws/operators/scales distinct; TV does not transfer unbounded cost.

assumptions: E has the same finite real Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure including dimension zero. V is C2 with alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta, all-point/all-vector alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I; eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

Construct the true Gaussian/Gibbs augmentation J, common Markov/disintegrating R/S, exact reflected S_y=(2x-y)#R_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), C2 and positive integrable partition.

For every fiber fix original dense closable exact compact-smooth gradient D_y with closed closure before epsilon/forcing. For each epsilon>0/f in L2(S_y), one actual u/G/r serves all C2 compact chi. Derive all local/global volume facts and PDE inputs from the accepted actual conditional localization. No measurable joint fiberwise solution/class selector, unreflected RGO identity or localized weighted-domain membership is assumed.
units.statement: Construct genuine common R/S and original fiber D_y before epsilon/f; choose ONE actual u before ALL C2 compact cutoffs. Retain all-domain variational identity, ordinary locally integrable u/G, all C1 compact directional weak-gradient tests, locally integrable squared r=epsilon*u+inner(grad W_y,G)-f, compact-volume L2 of u/G/r and all original C2 compact distribution tests. For every C2 compact chi retain v=chi*u, Gchi=chi*G+u*grad chi, Fchi=chi*r+2 inner(grad chi,G)+u Delta chi, all three global-volume L2/support inclusions, all C1 localized weak-gradient and C2 localized PDE identities with legal products. For each cutoff, Construct actual vc,Fc in complex L2(volume), with vc=volume-a.e. ofReal(v) and Fc=volume-a.e. ofReal(Fchi). For every complex Schwartz psi, both (Delta psi)*ofReal(v) and psi*ofReal(Fchi) are L1 and their integrals equal. For T_v=Lp.toTemperedDistribution(vc) and T_F=Lp.toTemperedDistribution(Fc), derive Delta T_v=T_F and MemSobolev 2 2 T_v. The latter uses B2 T=T-(2pi)^(-2) Delta T and a genuine complex L2 witness, not a supplied regularity result. Reflected/RGO laws/operators/quarter Hessian and Dirichlet scales remain distinct.
units.formula: \exists R,S\ \forall y\ \exists D_y\ \forall\varepsilon>0,f\ \exists u\ \forall\chi\in C_c^2\ \exists v_C,F_C:\quad v=\chi u,\ F_\chi=\chi r+2\langle\nabla\chi,G\rangle+u\Delta\chi,\quad\Delta T_v=T_{F_\chi},\quad\mathrm{MemSobolev}\ 2\ 2\ T_v.

steps.title: Consume the genuine common reflected conditional localization
steps.text: Call the accepted actual ConditionalLocalizedResolvent producer with source C2 V and exact curvature/eta cap. Retain common Markov R/S, true augmentation disintegration, reflection and actual positive reflected density; no unreflected RGO operator substitution.

steps.title: Keep the original D and choose one u before all cutoffs
steps.text: For each y keep original dense closable exact compact-smooth D_y and closed closure before epsilon/f. The accepted producer returns one actual u with all-domain variational equation, ordinary weak gradient/PDE and local squared/compact L2 facts before every cutoff.

steps.title: Derive the actual volume L2/support/PDE inputs for each cutoff
steps.text: Extract formula-defined v/Gchi/Fchi, all three global volume L2/support inclusions and genuine all-C1 first/all-C2 second weak equations from this same u. Keep every property; no Schwartz validity, final TD identity or regularity/core certificate is a new source assumption.

steps.title: Apply the real-test to complex Sobolev producer
steps.text: Use K=tsupport chi and actual compactness/support/L2/PDE conclusions to apply the new shared leaf. It constructs actual complex volume classes after each cutoff, every legal complex Schwartz identity, true TD Laplacian and Bessel-Sobolev membership. Fiberwise existences do not assert jointly measurable selectors.

steps.title: Exercise actual nonquadratic source and compact cutoff
steps.text: The Test uses V(x)=3x^2/8+sin(x)/8 with genuine curvature[1/2,1], eta in(0,1], an ordinary bump chi with rIn1/rOut2, actual C2 phi=rho(x)(x^2)^(5/2), all true source fibers/epsilon/forcing and originalD. It retains the particular gradient/PDE tests and extracts actual complex classes, all Schwartz integrabilities/equalities, TD equation and Sobolev result for the same cutoff u.

steps.title: Preserve source scaling and remaining obligations
steps.text: The reflected potential remains V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta), with quarter Hessian and distinct Dirichlet/epsilon scale from unreflected RGO. This complex regularity prerequisite does not establish real Hessian reps, weighted core/Bochner, BL/Poincare, joint fiber selection, main sampling guarantees or actual-input expected-cost composition.
